sonnet.problem: Stop 2 card 3 (Laodicea and Hierapolis) and card 4 (the brothers in Laodicea) have already told the baker 'Laodicea' by the time this fill-in-the-blank asks for 'Laodiceans', the church where the letter should also be read. The earlier story cards give away the answer, so the baker doesn't have to work it out.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
